name: note-card
title: Note card
description: A note as a card: title, a clamped preview, last edited time, a pin and a label, ready for a notes grid.
docs: note is { id, title, preview, editedAt, href, labels, code }. The card is one stretched link (note.href) or button (onOpen) with a ring around all of it on focus; the pin (pinned, onPinChange) and the menu (a list of { id, label, icon, destructive, onSelect }) sit above it as separate controls. A pinned note says "Pinned" in its footer as well as in the icon. Labels are { name, tone } with four tones, the name is always written out, and past maxLabels they fold into "+2". A note with no text shows "No content yet", code switches the preview to a monospace face, and NoteCardSkeleton is the loading state. Cards fill their grid cell, so a grid keeps equal heights.
